youtube.title: Ask Claude for a gear train: a GLSL shader, rendered as a seamless loop
youtube.description:
Ask Claude for a gear train, get a loop.
Claude wrote the shader: 24, 12 and 8 teeth, so the gears turn 1, 2 and 3 times per loop. funkbox rendered it and its loop check says the last frame flows into the first. No video model, just code. This 23 s Short rendered in 53 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
